initial_triage.item: DUT setting recommendations

Ensure the following settings on DUT > Disable the Windows* update process - Windows* key +R (RUN) -> services.msc -> Windows* Update -> Stop and Status type: Disabled - Windows* key+R (RUN) -> services.msc ->Windows* Search -> stop and change status type: Disabled - Windows* key+R (RUN) -> gpedit.msc -> Computer Configuration -> Administrative Templates -> Windows* - Components -> Windows* update -> Do not connect to any windows* update internet location -> Enabled > Disable OneDrive* - Windows* key+R (RUN) -> gpedit.msc -> Computer Configuration -> Administrative Templates -> Windows* Components -> OneDrive: - Prevent OneDrive files from syncing over metered connections -> Enabled - Prevent the usage of OneDrive for file storage -> Enabled - Prevent the usage of OneDrive for file storage on Windows* 8.1 -> Enabled > Disable Windows* Defender - Windows* key+R (RUN) -> gpedit.msc -> Computer Configuration -> Administrative Templates -> Windows* Components -> Windows* Defender Antivirus -> * Turn off Windows* Defender Antivirus-> Enabled * Turn off routine remediation -> Enabled > Disable the Windows* store - Windows* key+R (RUN) -> gpedit.msc -> Computer Configuration -> Administrative Templates -> Windows* Components -> Store - Turn off automatic download of updates on win8 machines -> Enabled - Turn off automatic download and install of updates -> Enabled - Turn off the offer to update to the latest version of windows* -> Enabled - Disable all apps from windows* store -> Enabled - Turn off the store application -> Enabled > Disable Windows* Telemetry service - Computer Configuration-> Administrative Templates-> Windows* components-> Data Collection and Preview Builds -> Allow telemetry -> set to Disabled Note: Sometimes, some of these processes may need to be re-enabled for executing some test cases (for example Windows* OneDrive*, Skype*, and so on). Enable those processes only when executing those test cases. Otherwise, keep them disabled.
Additional information about how to capture logs

Since WRT may interfere with OS log capturing, when collecting logs for a power consumption issue in Modern Standby, remove WRT completely before reproducing Follow these steps to collect OS log, WPR log and driver log: 1) Create folder c:\temp\power 2) Start WPR collection: wpr -start power 3) Start OS log collection: netsh trace start wireless_dbg traceFile=c:\temp\power\wireless_dbg_NetTrace.etl report=disable maxSize=1000 provider={21ba7b61-05f8-41f1-9048-c09493dcfe38} level=0xFF keywords=0xff provider="{DD7A21E6-A651-46D4-B7C2-66543067B869}" level=5 keywords=0x88075F3 4) Do repro steps (this phase will preferably be as short as possible, to avoid losing collected data due to capacity, but yet be sufficient to reproduce the issue) 5) Stop WPR (this might take a while): wpr -stop c:\temp\power\wpr.etl 6) Stop OS log collection (also might take a while): netsh trace stop 7) Generate sleepstudy report: powercfg /SleepStudy /output c:\temp\power\sleepstudy.html 8) Copy Wi-Fi auto-logger data: copy C:\WINDOWS\System32\LogFiles\WMI\Wifi*.* c:\temp\power\ Perform the following commands using tracelog.exe (part of WDK, it can be downloaded here) before copying: tracelog.exe -flush WiFiSession tracelog.exe -flush WiFiDriverIHVSession 9) Compress and provide all collected data (c:\temp\power)

initial_triage.item: If a recommendation for a better AP does not pop up when expected, check to see if the option "Pop up notifications for better access points" is enabled, and make sure the recommended AP is one of the previously-connected APs
initial_triage.example: "Pop up notifications for better access points" option shall be enabled

initial_triage.item: Additional information about how to capture logs

To capture aps.log, add the following registry key DWORD EnableFileLogging = 1​ under Computer\HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Intel\IntelConnect and log will be created in C:\ProgramData\Intel\ConnectivityService To capture aperture.log, add the following registry key DWORD EnableFileLogging = 1​ under Computer\HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Intel\IDBM and log will be created in C:\ProgramData\Intel\ConnectivityService To capture ICPSDbgLog.txt, add the following registry key DWORD App_EnableTraceLogs = 1​ under Computer\HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Intel\ICPS and log will be created under c:\users\public
